welcome: Welcome to Dhamani. Choose your language.
consent: Before you join: Dhamani stores your name, WhatsApp number, blood group, date of birth, sex, weight range, approximate location (to about 500 m), last donation date and alert choices. We use them only to alert you when someone near you needs a donor. Families and the public never see your number. Send STOP at any time and your profile is deleted within 7 days.
nameInvalid: Please send just your first name, for example Priya.
notSureEnd: No problem. Any blood centre can tell you your blood group. Send JOIN again when you know it.
askDob: What is your date of birth? Send it as DD-MM-YYYY, for example 05-08-1995.
dobInvalid: Please send the date as DD-MM-YYYY, for example 05-08-1995.
ageEnd: Thank you for wanting to help. Donors need to be 18 to 65 years old, so we cannot register you now.
weightEnd: Thank you for wanting to help. Donors need to weigh at least 45 kg, so we cannot register you now.
askLocation: Please share your location so we can alert you about requests nearby. Tap the attach button, choose Location, then send your current location. We keep it only to about 500 m.
locationInvalid: Please share a location pin: tap the attach button and choose Location.
askLastDonation: When did you last donate blood? Send the date as DD-MM-YYYY, or tap Never.
lastDonationInvalid: Please send the date as DD-MM-YYYY, or tap Never.
lastDonationFuture: That date is in the future. Please send the date of your last donation.
askRadius: How far can you travel to donate?
askNight: Can we alert you at night (11 pm to 6 am) for emergencies?
askRare: Your blood group is rare. Join the rare donor registry? Registry donors are alerted less often, mainly for patients who need a rare group.
done:
Thank you, {name}. You are registered. We will message you when someone near you needs a donor like you. The blood centre always does the final health check.

{help}
help:
Commands:
PAUSE 30: pause alerts for 30 days
STATUS: see your details
UPDATE: change your details
STOP: delete your profile
HELP: this list
notRegistered: You are not registered yet. Send JOIN to register as a blood donor.
alreadyRegistered: You are already registered. Send UPDATE to change your details, or STATUS to see them.
unknown: Sorry, I did not understand that. Send HELP to see what you can do.
pauseInvalid: Send PAUSE and a number of days from 1 to 365, for example PAUSE 30.
stopped: Done. You will not get any more alerts, and your profile will be deleted within 7 days. Send JOIN if you want to register again.
cancelled: Okay, registration cancelled. Send JOIN any time to start again.
alert: Blood needed near you: {group} {component} at {hospital}, {area}. Needed by {neededBy}, about {distance} km from you. Request {code}. Can you donate? The blood centre does the final health check.
prescreen: Thank you. One quick check: has any of this happened recently? New tattoo or piercing, fever or malaria, a vaccination, surgery, pregnancy or breastfeeding, antibiotics, or alcohol in the last 24 hours. The blood centre does the final check.
deferredThanks: Thank you for being honest. Please do not donate this time. We will alert you again when you can help.
askEta: When can you reach the hospital?
alreadyCovered: Thank you, this request is already covered. No need to go.
notNowThanks: No problem. Thank you for replying.
statusPing: Your request {code} is still open, with {count} donors confirmed so far. Is blood still needed?
stillNeededThanks: Thank you. We will keep looking for donors for {code}.
requestClosedOwner: Request {code} is now closed. Thank you for letting us know.
outcomeFulfilled: Request {code} now has enough donors. If you confirmed, please go as planned. Thank you.
outcomeClosed: Request {code} is closed. You do not need to go. Thank you for offering to help.
followup: Thank you for offering to help at {hospital} (request {code}). Were you able to donate?
donatedYesThanks: Thank you for donating. The family will confirm your arrival.
donatedNoThanks: Thank you for letting us know.
signedIn:
You are signed in to the Dhamani website. Go back to your browser to continue.

Never send a sign-in code that someone else gave you.
loginExpired: That sign-in code has expired or was already used. Please start again in the browser.

request_followup.body: Thank you for offering to help at {{1}} (request {{2}}). Were you able to donate?

eligible_again.body: Your donation interval ended on {{1}}. You can get alerts for nearby requests again. Keep alerts on?

donationVerified: Your donation for {code} at {hospital} is verified: you said you donated and the family confirmed you arrived. Thank you. Verified donations so far: {count}.
certNameAsk: To print your name on your donation certificate, please reply with your name in English letters, for example Priya K.
certNameInvalid: Please send your name in English letters only, for example Priya K.
eligibleAgain: Your donation interval ended on {date}. You can get alerts for nearby requests again. Keep alerts on?
meLink:
Your donor page, with your certificates. The link works for 24 hours:
{link}
recognitionAsk: Thank you for bringing new donors to Dhamani. {count} of the people you invited have donated blood. Dhamani coordinators would like to thank you publicly, for example on National Voluntary Blood Donation Day. May we show your first name and city? There is no prize or payment.
recognitionYesThanks: Thank you. A Dhamani coordinator may contact you through this chat.
recognitionNoThanks: Understood. We will not show your name anywhere.
